beschreibung: Greece head coach denies reports of Borussia Dortmund request to manage Konstantinos Karetsas’ workload – Greece national team head coach Ivan Jovanovic has denied a report that Borussia Dortmund issued a playing time request for club professional Konstantinos Karetsas.
Cologne suffer double striker injury blow ahead of crucial Bundesliga derby – FC Cologne have lost their two leading goal scorers ahead of a crucial Bundesliga derby against Borussia Mönchengladbach.
